svg.title: PacketPath system flowchart
svg.desc: Complete data flow and module interactions for PacketPath network boot sequencer and adaptive scheduler

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is the dependency graph represented?')
sendPrompt('What happens if a cycle is detected?')
sendPrompt('How does the recursive DFS topological sort work?')
sendPrompt('What happens in the boot sequence?')
g.text: Spawn services in topological order via threads

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens when a service fails?')
g.text: Mark FAILED, propagate to dependents via BFS

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the scheduler handle multithreading?')

g.text: High-priority task arrives → Pause low-priority → Resume high

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the aging algorithm prevent starvation?')
g.text: Background thread monitors wait times every X seconds
Increase priority of waiting tasks → Re-sort queue
NIGHT_HOURS: Boost backup / data sync priorities
